title: High moments of random multiplicative functions twisted by Fourier coefficients of modular forms
summary: Let $λ(n)$ denote the Fourier coefficients of a fixed modular form and $h(n)$ a Steinhaus or Rademacher random multiplicative function. In this paper, we determine, under the generalized Riemann hypothesis, the order of magnitude of $\E|\sum_{n \leq x} h(n)λ(n)|^{2q}$ up to factors of size $e^{O(q^2)}$, for all real $x, q$ with $1 \leq q \leq c\log x/\log\log x $ and $c>0$ a small constant.
